metadata_scope: compact public model card; private captures, per-frame manifests and run artifacts excluded
intended_use: Experimental English PS2 LOADING-text classification on the raw capture ROI; limited validation

training.method: custom offline classifier-only fine-tune; generic train.py does not reproduce these weights
training.normal_sampling: one randperm without replacement per epoch; all unique TRAIN indices
training.replay_sampling: seeded shuffled cycles of the three designated TRAIN hard negatives
training.positive_class_weight_source: normal TRAIN negative/positive ratio; excludes replay duplication
training.training_loss: class-weighted BCEWithLogitsLoss on normal+replay plus logit_anchor * MSE on original-TRAIN normal samples; classifier-only Adam update
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation BCE among eligible trained checkpoints
training.augmentation: existing train.augment on TRAIN only, including replay: translation +/-2.88 px, gain 0.8-1.2, Gaussian noise sigma 0.012

logit_anchor.teacher: detached frozen clones of initial classifier weight and bias
logit_anchor.features: one frozen convolution pass on the same augmented batch for teacher and student
logit_anchor.mask: normal samples from original 11 TRAIN groups only; excludes entire migrated group and all appended replay

training.reproducibility: The reviewed dataset and custom run artifacts are private; this repository supplies inference weights and provenance, not a publicly reproducible training run.

lineage.current_gradient_sources: current TRAIN, including migrated prior TEST recording
lineage.migrated_recording: Entire 6267-input HUD recording moved from prior TEST to current TRAIN after false-positive inspection

evaluation_protocol.limitation: Warm retraining from the all-session checkpoint. Its gradient sources are now TRAIN, but its checkpoint was selected on the same reused VAL recordings. One prior TEST recording (all 6267 examples) was migrated into TRAIN after inspecting its false positives. The two remaining negative-only TEST recordings were evaluated previously and are reused, so this is not a fresh benchmark. TEST was not inferred during this run until checkpoint selection was complete. No held-out positive TEST recall is available. The user fixed threshold 0.8; there was no threshold search. Three TRAIN hard negatives and VAL determine eligibility; lowest unweighted VAL BCE selects among eligible trained epochs. Only the classifier is trained; both convolution layers remain bitwise equal to initialization. The logit anchor uses the original classifier and the same augmented frozen features only on normal samples from the original 11 TRAIN groups, excluding the entire migrated group and replay entries.

runtime_verification.scope: Numerical inference agreement, not an accuracy benchmark on new recordings

label_review.limitation: Five inspected label-0 cases visibly contain LOADING; no blanket conclusion or relabeling claim about all other nominal false positives is warranted.

limitations: Reused validation and negative-only test after prior model selection and two validation-guided rejected trials; not a fresh benchmark.
Validation positives are 21 adjacent frames from one contiguous loading event.
Remaining test has no positives; positive test recall, F1 and balanced accuracy are null.
The designated HUD recording and replay examples are training data, so their results are training regressions.
Full TRAIN retains 98 nominal false positives and 2 false negatives at threshold 0.8; some reviewed negative labels are erroneous.
Performance on new recordings, capture settings and platforms is unestablished; confidence is not a calibrated probability.
